name: App
description: Application object. new OGX.App loads www/app.json. Read oml://app for the file layout.
access: Created in JavaScript with new OGX.App(options). It is not an OML node. The test app keeps the instance in the app variable and calls app.goto, app.cfind, and app.addPopup.

methods.name: goto
methods.description: Navigates with the router. The options object defaults to history true, reload false, and data null.

methods.name: getURL
methods.description: Returns the router URL.

methods.name: getJSON
methods.description: Returns a clone of a preloaded JSON document.

methods.name: getOML
methods.description: Returns a clone of a preloaded OML document.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Returns one top-level key of the loaded app config.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Runs OGX.Net.refresh on the preloaded files.

methods.name: addStage
methods.description: Creates a stage, merges defaults.stage, and adds it. config.id is required. The third argument defaults to true.

methods.name: addPopup
methods.description: Creates a popup. The second argument is the Uxi to create it from. defaults.popup is merged into the config. Height auto is ignored unless scroll is true.

methods.name: addWindow
methods.description: Creates a window. The second argument defaults to the current stage. defaults.window is merged into the config.

methods.name: addOverlay
methods.description: Adds an overlay on a node. The anim falls back to defaults.overlay.anim. The node falls back to the current stage. Returns true when a node received it.

methods.name: removeOverlay
methods.description: Calls removeOverlay on the node. The node defaults to the current stage. Returns the app.

methods.name: getPopups
methods.description: Gathers Popup nodes. A string argument filters id with that regular expression.

methods.name: popupExists
methods.description: True when cfind finds a Popup with that id.

methods.name: findPopup
methods.description: Accepts an element, or an object with el. Walks up to .ogx_popup and returns that Popup. Returns false when none is found.

methods.name: getVisiblePopups
methods.description: Returns visible popups. The stage defaults to the current stage. Pass true to use children instead of gather.

methods.name: moveNode
methods.description: Detaches the node and attaches it to the parent. The third argument is passed to attach.

methods.name: dropNode
methods.description: Removes a Stage or a View from OGX.Stages or OGX.Views. Pass the node, or pass the name and the class name.

methods.name: isDarkMode
methods.description: Returns whether dark mode is on.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Swaps the media queries of the light and dark stylesheets.

methods.name: splash
methods.description: Returns the splash object when splash is set in the config. That object has show() and hide(callback). app.splash.hide() hides it and then destroys it. OGX.Splash.DONE is the string SplashDone.

events.name: OGX.App.LOADING
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is AppLoading.

events.name: OGX.App.READY
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is AppReady.

events.name: OGX.App.DUPLICATE
events.description: Runtime constant. The event string is AppDuplicate.

catalog_status: Methods in this file are present on the object returned by new OGX.App in the runtime the test app loads. Further methods are not listed. Do not invent members that are absent.
